data.title: 双叶理央 · 书店科学区的新刊
data.description: 书店角落，她站在科学新书架前快速翻阅目录，发现想买的书时眼睛微微发亮；购物篮里却同时躺着一本恋爱小说，是她不示人的另一面。
data.action: 书店角落，她站在科学新书架前快速翻阅目录，发现想买的书时眼睛微微发亮
data.promptProse: At the bookstore's new science shelf, Rio marks a promising chapter in an open table of contents with one finger. A paperback novel remains beside the technical volume in her shopping basket. Grey cardigan and glasses frame newly interested brown eyes in the medium side view. Warm shop light falls over the open page and basket rim; nearby book spines recede along shelves with darker gaps between them.
